markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the election winner is officially declared or certified.
markets.rules_primary: If Pangu wins the 2027 Papua New Guinean general election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For parliamentary/legislative elections, the winner is the party, coalition, or alliance winning the most seats in the specified chamber. If two parties have the same number of seats, the one with the higher share of the vote will resolve to Yes and all others to No.

Seats are counted as declared by the Papua New Guinea Electoral Commission at the return of the writs, for the party each winning candidate was endorsed by at the election. A party counts only for its own endorsed candidates; a coalition formed after the election does not count, and neither do later changes of party. Independents are not a party. A party's share of the vote is the first-preference votes for its endorsed candidates across all electorates, as published by the Commission.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if certified election results are published.
markets.rules_primary: If Morena finishes in 2nd place in the 2027 Mexican Chamber of Deputies election according to the certified results, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Ranking is determined by the specified counting method. For proportional representation, rank follows the electoral authority's final seat allocation order.

Rank is determined by the total number of seats awarded to each party in the Chamber of Deputies, including district and proportional representation seats. Where seat rank and vote-share rank differ, the certified seat allocation governs.

If parties have the same number of seats, the certified raw vote count breaks the tie. If parties remain tied, they share the ranks they jointly occupy. In case of exact ties, markets resolve proportionally (1/number of tied entities), with the Yes payout rounded down.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the Riksdag approves a new Prime Minister in a vote on the Speaker's proposal before Nov 13, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Speaker presenting or announcing a proposal for Prime Minister, a party leader being tasked with exploring a government, an announced agreement between parties, a Riksdag vote that rejects the Speaker's proposal, and the continued operation of the outgoing caretaker government do NOT qualify.

A proposal is approved unless more than half of the Riksdag's members (at least 175 of 349) vote against it. A proposal approved with more members voting no than yes qualifies. Approval of a proposal naming any person qualifies, including outgoing Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson. Approval by a Riksdag chosen in an extraordinary election qualifies. The approving vote itself counts; the later change of government at the Council of State is not required.

If the Riksdag has not approved a Prime Minister before a market's date, that market resolves to No.

markets.rules_primary: If legislation or budget language requiring data centers to procure a minimum share of their electricity or associated renewable energy certificates from carbon-free resources, or barring dedicated fossil-fueled generation from serving them, either directly or as a condition of a tax preference or permit is enacted in Virginia before Aug 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

If the State of Delaware reports Franchise Tax receipts for FY2027 above 

$1.344 billion, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Resolution uses gross Franchise Tax receipts for Delaware fiscal year 2027, covering July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, as reported in the State’s Statement of General Fund Receipts and Refund Disbursements by Major Category. It does not include Bank Franchise Tax, which Delaware reports separately, and it does not subtract Franchise Tax refund disbursements.

Resolution uses the first State of Delaware monthly financial report containing the complete June 30, 2027 fiscal-year total; subsequent revisions do not affect resolution.

markets.rules_primary:
If the June 2027 BLS Employment Cost Index value used under Connecticut General Statutes §31-58 produces a Connecticut minimum fair wage for January 1, 2028 that is above 

$18.00 per hour, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Under Connecticut law, the January 1, 2028 rate is determined by the 12-month percentage change in the applicable ECI through June 30, 2027, with the resulting wage rounded to the nearest cent.

Resolution uses the 12-month percent change ending June 2027, not seasonally adjusted, for wages and salaries for all civilian workers. The January 1, 2028 minimum wage is calculated by applying that percentage change to the January 1, 2027 Connecticut minimum wage of $17.48 and rounding the resulting hourly wage to the nearest cent, consistent with Connecticut General Statutes §31-58. The market does not rely on the timing or wording of a subsequent Connecticut government announcement.

Resolution source: United States Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics - Employment Cost Index, Table 8: Employment Cost Index for wages and salaries, for civilian workers, by occupational group and industry, not seasonally adjusted.

markets.rules_secondary:
The league must officially announce that the city has been awarded an expansion franchise. This requires formal approval by the league's Board of Governors or equivalent governing body specifically naming the city. Preliminary discussions, stadium approvals without franchise awards, feasibility studies, or being named as a potential market do not qualify. Franchise relocations only count if specifically designated as "expansion" by the league. The announcement must come after market issuance. Even if the team won't begin play until after the target date, the market resolves Yes upon the official award announcement. Awards to nearby cities in the same region only count if they specifically include the named city or its metropolitan area.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if any component becomes impossible to occur (resolving to No) or all components have been satisfied (resolving to Yes).
markets.no_sub_title: Hormuz traffic: Back to normal, Gas price: Below $3.40
markets.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Hormuz traffic: Back to normal, Gas price: Below $3.40, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Hormuz traffic is “Back to normal” if the 7-day moving average of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch is above 60 at any time before Jul 1, 2027, and “Not back to normal” if it is not, and Gas price refers to the AAA national average price for regular gasoline on Jul 31, 2027.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Hormuz traffic (POLITICALSTAT), Gas price (AAAGAS). markets.early_close_condition: This market may close and expire early after BLS publishes the initial corrugated recyclable paper price index for the specified reporting month, in accordance with the Contract rules.
markets.rules_primary: If the Producer Price Index by Commodity: Pulp, Paper, and Allied Products: Corrugated Recyclable Paper (BLS series WPU09120325; not seasonally adjusted; index June 2006=100) for March 2027 is above 60 index points, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Producer Price Index by Commodity: Pulp, Paper, and Allied Products: Corrugated Recyclable Paper, series WPU09120325, for March 2027. It is the not-seasonally-adjusted index level, June 2006=100, expressed in index points. This provides index-based OCC exposure, not a dollar price per ton.

This market expressly uses the first value published by BLS for that reporting month, including an initially preliminary value. Subsequent revisions and corrections do not affect resolution. The comparison is strictly greater than the strike, using the original BLS-reported precision without additional rounding; equality resolves to No. BLS is the binding source. FRED (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU09120325) is a reference display; revised FRED history is not a substitute for the original BLS publication.

If publication is delayed, trading remains closed and determination waits for publication, subject to the Contract's expiration and data-unavailability provisions. The publication deadline for this event is July 14, 2027 at 10:00 AM EDT. Missing data and outcome reviews follow the Contract's Expiration and Contingencies provisions.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Bureau of Labor Statistics. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

custom_strike.Option: the candidate of the registered alliance that includes the Unión Cívica Radical

markets.early_close_condition: This market may close and expire early once the outcome can be determined under the contract's Payout Criterion.
markets.rules_primary: If the candidate of the registered alliance that includes the Unión Cívica Radical wins the 2027 Santa Fe gubernatorial election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

An alliance registered with the Tribunal Electoral of the Province of Santa Fe for the 2027 provincial elections counts, and a party running alone is an alliance of one. Alliance membership is fixed at registration; later changes do not move a candidate. An alliance's candidate is the person heading the governor and vice-governor formula it fields in the general election. If one alliance includes more than one of the Unión Cívica Radical, the Partido Justicialista and La Libertad Avanza, it counts only for the one named first in that order.
markets.subtitle: :: Unión Cívica Radical
markets.title: Will the candidate of the registered alliance that includes the Unión Cívica Radical win the 2027 Santa Fe gubernatorial election?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the election winner is officially declared or certified.
markets.rules_primary: If DPS wins the next Podgorica municipal election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
DPS: Any formally registered electoral list containing the Democratic Party of Socialists of Montenegro (DPS).

PES: Any formally registered electoral list containing the Europe Now Movement (PES), provided that the list does not contain DPS.

NSD: Any formally registered electoral list containing New Serb Democracy (NSD), provided that the list does not contain DPS or PES.

URA: Any formally registered electoral list containing United Reform Action (URA), provided that the list does not contain DPS, PES or NSD.

The winner is the list that wins the most seats in the Podgorica City Assembly. A list's seats are those the Election Commission of the Capital City of Podgorica allocates to that list. If two lists tie in seats, the one with the higher share of the valid votes cast in the election resolves to Yes and all others to No.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

markets.rules_primary: If Kalonzo Musyoka wins the contest to be named the presidential flagbearer of Kenya's United Opposition for the 2027 general election by June 11, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The United Opposition is Kenya's opposition coalition of the Wiper Patriotic Front, Democracy for Citizens, Jubilee, People's Liberation, Democratic and DAP-K parties, including under any new name or registered coalition vehicle (such as the United Alternative Government or The Ukombozi Alliance, formerly Azimio la Umoja). A person is named when at least four of these six parties have each publicly announced or adopted that person, together or separately, as the coalition's single presidential candidate, directly or through such a vehicle. If the coalition replaces its candidate before the deadline, the last person named this way counts. A party's own nomination, an opinion poll or vote, or individual leaders' endorsements do not count, and a party leaving or naming its own candidate does not stop the others' announcement from counting. If no person is named this way by the deadline, every market resolves No. Dates are East Africa Time.

markets.rules_primary: If Kash Patel leaves (or announces they will leave) the Trump administration after Issuance and before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves when the departure is publicly announced by the person, the President, the White House or their agency, regardless of the effective date. Only announcements after Issuance count, and unconfirmed reports from unnamed officials do not.

Leaving the Trump administration means no longer holding any executive branch position; the Federal Reserve and federal courts are not part of it. For military officers, retirement or removal from their post counts, but reassignment does not. Leaving one role does not count if a move to, or keeping, another administration position is announced at the same time or earlier, such as Deputy Attorney General to Attorney General or Deputy Chief of Staff to Chief of Staff; a position announced afterward does not change the outcome. A departure taking effect at the end of the term on Jan 20, 2029 does not count.

If the person dies in office, contracts on them may resolve to the last fair price as determined by the Exchange.

This market resolves when the departure is publicly announced by the person, the President, the White House or their agency, regardless of the effective date. Only announcements after Issuance count, and unconfirmed reports from unnamed officials do not.

Leaving the Trump administration means no longer holding any executive branch position; the Federal Reserve and federal courts are not part of it. For military officers, retirement or removal from their post counts, but reassignment does not. Leaving one role does not count if a move to, or keeping, another administration position is announced at the same time or earlier, such as Deputy Attorney General to Attorney General or Deputy Chief of Staff to Chief of Staff; a position announced afterward does not change the outcome. A departure taking effect at the end of the term on Jan 20, 2029 does not count.

If the person dies in office, contracts on them may resolve to the last fair price as determined by the Exchange.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the federal government resumes garnishing the wages of borrowers in default on federal student loans after Issuance and before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The federal government means the U.S. Department of Education, the U.S. Department of the Treasury, or a collector acting for either. Garnishing wages means a wage withholding order is issued to a borrower's employer, or wages are actually withheld, to collect a defaulted federal student loan. Garnishment by FFEL guaranty agencies, states or private lenders is outside this market.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Notices of intent to garnish wages, or hearings on them, without a withholding order issued to an employer
An announcement, plan or schedule that garnishment will or may restart on a future date, including the hiring of collection contractors
Treasury offset of tax refunds, Social Security, federal salaries or other federal payments
markets.title: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that the federal government resumes garnishing the wages of borrowers in default on federal student loans before Jul 1, 2027?

events.title: Will federal student loan wage garnishment resume before Jul 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If a New York State court issues an order prohibiting, suspending, or pausing the opening or operation of at least one planned New York City municipal grocery store in Multicultural Business Coalition v. City of New York, Index Nos. 160693/2026 and 160694/2026, or a proceeding formally related to, consolidated with, transferred from, renumbering, succeeding, or reviewing either named matter and concerning the same requested relief before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.rules_primary: If a U.S. state other than Texas, Florida or Rhode Island has banned, suspended or paused law enforcement use of Flock Safety or other automated license plate reader cameras after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying action is enacted legislation, an executive order, a court order applying statewide, or a binding directive from a state official or agency with statewide authority, that prohibits, suspends or pauses the installation or operation of Flock Safety or other automated license plate reader cameras by law enforcement.

Any action by Texas, Florida or Rhode Island does not count, including further or expanded action by those states.

The following count:

A statewide ban or moratorium on new law enforcement ALPR installations
A statewide order pausing or suspending operation of cameras already installed
A ban or pause that covers only state roads or other state-owned property, or only state agencies
A binding directive from a state official with statewide authority, even where it reaches state agencies such as the state police in the first instance
A measure with a delayed effective date, so long as the action itself is taken before the market's date

The following do NOT count:

Action by a city, county, school district or any other political subdivision rather than the state
Conditions on use rather than a prohibition, suspension or pause, including purpose limits, data retention limits, warrant requirements, audit requirements and restrictions on data sharing
A freeze or cut in state funding that does not itself prohibit or pause installation or operation of the cameras
A non-binding request, recommendation or urging that a locality is free to disregard
A review, study or task force that has not itself imposed a ban, suspension or pause
A law enforcement agency's own decision to stop using cameras where the state has not required it
Anything that happened before Issuance

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

markets.rules_primary: If Mexico agrees to or announces a cut below 50% in the import duty on at least one covered class of passenger cars originating in China after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The tariff refers to the 50% import duty on passenger-car classes under heading 8703 in the Dec 29, 2025 decree published in the Diario Oficial de la Federación. Announcements with specified future implementation dates qualify.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of an international treaty, accord, or binding agreement
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings

markets.rules_primary: If an act permanently lowering the state sales and use tax on food (SNAP-eligible groceries) below 2% is enacted in Alabama before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If Sébastien Lecornu leaves (or announces he will leave) as Prime Minister of France before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

A resignation tendered by Sébastien Lecornu counts when it is announced or tendered. This includes the resignation of the Government that Article 50 of the French Constitution requires after the Assemblée nationale adopts a motion of censure or withholds its confidence, and the customary resignation of the Government after a presidential election. It counts even if he continues to handle current affairs until a successor is named, and even if he is named Prime Minister again afterwards.

The following do NOT resolve this market to YES:
A statement that Sébastien Lecornu is not a candidate in the 2027 presidential election, or that governments customarily resign after a presidential election, unless it also says he will leave office.
A motion of censure or a confidence vote that the Assemblée nationale does not adopt.
A dissolution of the Assemblée nationale, on its own.
A resignation that the President declines, so that the Government's functions do not end.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_primary: If, after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, Lai Ching-te visits the United States of America by physically travelling to and being present within its geographic boundaries, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

markets.rules_primary: If a national ban on commercial whaling has become law in Iceland before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a “commercial whaling ban” means a legally effective Icelandic governmental measure, whether legislation, executive order, administrative regulation, or another governmental measure, that generally prohibits commercial whaling in Icelandic waters and removes commercial authorization across all species then authorized under Icelandic law, currently fin whales and minke whales. It may use any legal vehicle and may contain separate scientific or noncommercial exceptions, provided commercial whaling is not generally authorized.

A measure limited to a season, quota, area, species, company, or individual permit, a temporary suspension, permit non-use, or operator inactivity does NOT qualify. A proposal, draft, non-binding resolution, or measure not legally effective before the deadline does NOT qualify. Enactment occurs when applicable legal requirements are complete and the measure is legally effective before the deadline.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If all 27 EU member states agree to or announce the final agreed terms of the overall political agreement on the 2028-2034 EU long-term budget (MFF), as officially declared by the European Council to have been reached by all 27 EU member states before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The European Council must officially declare that all 27 EU member states have reached political agreement on the overall 2028-2034 MFF terms. A commitment or timetable to reach agreement later, a negotiating box, a partial or sectoral mandate, or a package leaving MFF-level terms unresolved does not qualify. European Parliament consent, formal legislative adoption, and entry into force are not required.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where all 27 EU member states are signatories also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments
